hooks.command: if [ -n "$PASEO_TERMINAL_ID" ]; then "${PASEO_HOOK_CLI:-paseo}" hooks codex PermissionRequest; fi
hooks.commandWindows: if defined PASEO_TERMINAL_ID (if defined PASEO_HOOK_CLI ("%PASEO_HOOK_CLI%" hooks codex PermissionRequest) else (paseo hooks codex PermissionRequest)) else (exit /b 0)

hooks.command: if [ -n "$PASEO_TERMINAL_ID" ]; then "${PASEO_HOOK_CLI:-paseo}" hooks codex PostToolUse; fi
sh -c 'if ! command -v entire >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; exec entire hooks codex post-tool-use'
if [ -n "$PASEO_TERMINAL_ID" ]; then "${PASEO_HOOK_CLI:-paseo}" hooks codex PreToolUse; fi

hooks.command: sh -c 'if ! command -v entire >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; exec entire hooks codex session-end'
